deviation: Clause 6.1 gives the Supplier ownership of the Services and all related software, documentation and improvements, with no ownership or licence for bespoke deliverables, so Arcadia would not own what it pays to have created. No perpetual licence is granted either, which is below the playbook fallback. Customer Data ownership in 6.2 is acceptable.
suggested_text: 6.1 The Customer owns all right, title and interest in all deliverables created specifically for the Customer under this Agreement, including all intellectual property rights in them. The Supplier retains ownership of its pre-existing tools, software and materials (the "Supplier Tools") and grants the Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use the Supplier Tools as incorporated in or necessary to use the deliverables. Except as expressly stated, no other rights are granted. 6.2 The Customer owns all right, title and interest in the Customer Data. The Customer grants the Supplier a limited licence to process Customer Data solely to provide the Services in accordance with this Agreement and the DPA.
